translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Katoula okanavina karaiwogala
E Guyau iluki Mosese sola Eroni karaiwaga makwaisina.
Ka, kidamwa availa kwaitala kala pwasa kaina kala pukuna kaina sapila wala okanuvinela, makwaina igau bivigaki kala kagwaiguya, ibodi matauna bimiakaisi baisa taitala matausina tolula Eroni dalela.

E tolula ibodi bimitakavati pwasa makwaina, e kidamwa unuunula wowola olumoulela pwasa bipupwakausi deli pwasa makwaina bikombonu sitana, makwaina kagwaiguya, e tolula matauna bikamituli tomota matauna topupagatu.

Mitaga kidamwa pwasa makwaina kwepupwakau wala e gala bikombonu bila olumoulela deli unuunula wowola gala iyapupwakausi, e tolula ibodi bikatupali tau matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam.

Tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna tuvaila avai tuta bibudoki kwailima kwaiyuwela yam, e kidamwa idoki pwasa makwaina makala gigisa wala gala ikikabaiveka, tolula matauna bikatumkulovi kala yam tau matauna biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam tuvaila.

Tolula matauna bimitakavati matauna tuvaila oyamla bibudoki kwailima kwaiyuwela, e kidamwa pwasa makwaina gala ikabaiveka bogwa leibwaina, e tolula bikamituli matauna tomigileu paila pwasa makwaina pwasamakava wala. E tomota matauna ibodi biwini kala kwama komwaidona e matauna bogwa wala bimigileu.
Mitaga kidamwa tolula bogwa eimitakavati kala pwasa deli eikamituli matauna tomigileu oluviga pwasa makwaina bikabaiveka, tau matauna ibodi bikaimilavau baisa tolula.
E tolula bimitakavati matauna tuvaila, e kidamwa pwasa makwaina bogwa eikabaiveka tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu, e makwaina kala kagwaiguya.
Kidamwa availa biyosi kagwaiguya matauna ibodi bimiakaisi tolula
e tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna. Kidamwa kala pwasa okanuvinela kwepupwakau e unuunula wowola bipupwakau wala deli ivakasau polala,
e kagwaiguya makwaina kwemyuvau. E tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu; e gala ibodi bikatupali matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu paila bogwa eivitoki tolosila matauna topupagatu.
Ka, kidamwaga kagwaiguya makwaina biyouloveka bikomkuwosi wowola tomwaidona opwanetala bila okwaibakwaila

e tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna tuvaila, kidamwa bibani mokwitatoula wala bogwa eikomkuwosi tomwaidona, e tolula bikamituli tau matauna bogwa eimigileu. E kidamwaga komwaidona wowola bogwa eipupwakau, matauna mokwita wala bogwa eimigileu.
Mitaga avai tuta wala pwasa biyoulapula owowola e tau matauna topupagatu wala.

Oluvi tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna tuvaila, e kidamwa bigisi bogwa wala mokwita kala pwasa, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu. E pwasa makwaina eiyomitali kagwaiguya, e tau matauna topupagatu wala.
Mitaga avai tuta pwasa makwaina eibwaina bivapupwakau tuvaila, e tau matauna ibodi bikaimilavau baisa tolula,
e tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna tuvaila. Kidamwa pwasa makwaina bogwa eipupwakau, matauna bogwa eimigileu e tolula bikamituli matauna bogwa eimigileu.
Kidamwa availa kwaitala kala pukuna makwaina bogwa leibwaina
mitaga kidamwa bimyuvau bisapila kaina bisukwanekwana onebala pukuna makwaina, e matauna ibodi bilokaia tolula.

E tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna, kidamwa bigisi pwasa makwaina bikombonu bila sitana olumoulela deli unuunula wowola olumoulela pwasa bipupwakau, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu. Paila kagwaiguya makwaina eivitouula metoya wa pukuna makwaina.

Mitaga kidamwa tolula bimitakavati e bibani unuunula wowola olumoulela pwasa makwaina gala idavila bipupwakau deli gala ikombonu bila sitana olumoulela, mitaga bogwa leibwabwaina, e tolula ibodi bikatupali matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam.
Kidamwa pwasa makwaina bikabaiveka e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu; matauna bogwa eikatoula.
Mitaga kidamwa pwasa makwaina makala gigisa wala gala ikikabaiveka baisa pukuna makwaina nebala, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna bogwa eimigileu.
E kidamwa taitala tau bigabu kova, e bivakabinini kanuvinela bipupwakau kaina bikulubweyani,

tolula ibodi bimitakavati tau matauna. E kidamwa unuunula wowola olumoulela pwasa makwaina bipupwakau deli bikombonu sitana bila olumoulela, makwaina kagwaiguya leivitouula metoya kova leigabu matauna, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu.

Mitaga kidamwa unuunula wowola olumoulela pwasa makwaina gala ipupwakau gala ikombonu ila olumoulela sitana bogwa leibwabwaina tolula ibodi bikatupali matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam.

Avai tuta bibudoki kwailima kwaiyuwela yam tolula ibodi bimitakavati tau matauna tuvaila, mitaga kidamwa pwasa makwaina ikikabaiveka makwaina kagwaiguya, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu.

Mitaga kidamwa pwasa makwaina makala gigisa wala gala ikikabaiveka deli bogwa eibwabwaina makwaina gala kagwaiguya. E tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna bogwa eimigileu paila baisa kala neba wala metoya kova leigabu.
Kidamwa taitala tau kaina natana vivila kala pwasa opwanetala kaina okimwala,

tolula ibodi bimitakavati pwasa makwaina. Kidamwa bikombonu sitana bila olumoulela e unuunula wowola wa pwasa eivapupwakau deli yasisikwa bogwa eikamituli makwaina kagwaiguya, e tolula bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu.

Mitaga kidamwa tolula bimitakavati matauna, e pwasa makwaina gala bikombonu, deli unuunula wowola wa pwasa gala isusinasi, tolula ibodi bikatupali tau matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam.

E avai tuta kwailima kwaiyuwela yam bibudoki, tolula ibodi bimitakavati pwasa makwaina tuvaila. Kidamwa pwasa makwaina gala bikabaiveka e unuunula wowola wa pwasa gala ivapupwakau deli gala bikombonu bila sitana olumoulela,
tau matauna ibodi biviliu papala pwasa makwaina opwanetala bitavina wala bitapatu. E tolula ibodi bikatupali tau matauna bim ituwoli la kabosisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam tuvaila.

E avai tuta kwailima kwaiyuwela yam bibudoki, tolula ibodi bimitakavati pwasa makwaina tuvaila, e kidamwa gala ikabaiveka deli ikombonu bila sitana olumoulela tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna tomigileu. E tau matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa komwaidona e matauna bogwa bimigileu.
Mitaga kidamwa tolula bogwa eikamituli matauna tomigileu, e oluviga pwasa makwaina bimyuvau bikabaiveka,

tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna tuvaila. E kidamwa pwasa makwaina mokwita bogwa eikabaiveka tolula gala bikaiki wowola paila bimitakavati tau matauna unuunula wowola miyasina bogwa eivapupwakau, paila bogwa eikamituli matauna topupagatu.
Mitaga kidamwa tolula la nanamsa idoki pwasa makwaina gala ikabaiveka deli unuunula wowola eisususinasi deli pwasa makwaina bogwa leibwaina, e tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna bogwa eimigileu.
Kidamwa taitala tau kaina natana vivila vana bikikapwalasi owowola,
e tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna kaina minana. E kidamwa vana makwaisina kwetubumyou, e makwaisina kala kaisegita wala eikikapwalasi owowola, mapaila matauna kaina minana wowola migileu wala.
Kidamwa taitala tau kulula bitatotinasi okaigadula kaina omatala, baisa gala bivigaki matauna topupagatu.
Mitaga kidamwa bikompwala kwaitala pwasa okala bakana, makwaina kagwaiguya.
E tolula ibodi bimitakavati matauna, e kidamwa bigisi kwaitala pwasa,
tolula ibodi bikamituli tau matauna topupagatu, paila makwaina pwasa kagwaiguya opwanetala.
Availa biyosi kagwaiguya ibodi bisisikam yapupagatu karekwa, gala bisinati kulula, bikapoli migila makabulona watanawa, e bikawota kawala, “Pupagatu, pupagatu!”
E makala kala kaduwonaku lelia makwaina bigugweimili, matauna bisisu wala topupagatu, mapaila matauna ibodi bisim oyosewala kabosikaiwa, e bisikaduwonaku wala metoya tomota komwaidona.
Kulisosou karaiwogala
Kidamwa kulisosou
bikana okarekwa miyasina, eiyoudulaisi metoya sipi unuunula kaina miyasina yakakalaia,
kaina msomsela miyasina karekwa, kaina okanuvinesi mauna, kaina avai vavagi wala eiyoudulaisi metoya mauna kanuvinesi,
kidamwa kulisosou makwaina kala gigisa semitamata kaina bweyani, kulisosou makwaina kwekikapela mapaila ibodi wala guguwa makwaina bivitulokaisi tolula.
E tolula ibodi bimitakavati makwaina e bikatupali bim wala kabala ituwoli biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam.
Avai tuta bibudoki yam kwailima kwaiyuwela, matauna ibodi bimitakavati tuvaila, e kidamwa kulisosou makwaina bikabaiveka, guguwa makwaina kwepupagatu.
E tolula ibodi bigabu guguwa makwaina, paila kulisosou makwaina kwekikapela, mapaila ibodi wala guguwa makwaina bigabu.
Mitaga kidamwa avai tuta tolula bimitakavati e ibani kulisosou gala wala ikabaiveka oguguwa makwaina,
e tolula matauna bikaraiwogi biwinaisi e bikatupalaisi bim wala kabala ituwoli ikanam biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam tuvaila.

Avai tuta kwailima kwaiyuwela yam bibudoki matauna ibodi bimitakavati makwaina kidamwa kulisosou baisa gala bididavila kala gigisa, deli gala ikikabaiveka makwaina kwepupagatu wala; kidamwa kulisosou bikapilaki olopola kaina otapwala guguwa makwaina, ibodi wala bukugabwaisi.
Mitaga kidamwa avai tuta tolula bimitakavati tuvaila, e kulisosou bogwa leiwokuva, matauna ibodi bikisi makatupona metoya okarekwa kaina kanuvinesi mauna leiyoudulokaisi avai vavagi.
Oluvi kidamwa kulisosou bivigavau tuvaila, e eikikabaiveka tuvaila, e toliguguwa ibodi bigabu guguwa makwaina.
Mitaga kidamwa matauna biwini guguwa makwaina deli kulisosou biwokuva, matauna ibodi wala biwinavau tuvaila, e bogwa wala bimigileu mokwita.

Ka, baisa makawala karaiwogala kulisosou avai tuta bikana okarekwa, miyasina yakakalaia kaina miyasina eibisikaisi metoya sipi unuunusi kaina miyasina yabisibasi kaina yaviriviri kaina goli avai vavagi wala leiyoudulokaisi metoya mauna kanuvinesi. Baisa makawala karaiwogala guguwa makwaisina kaina kwemigileu kaina kwepupagatu.

footnotes.text: Mina Iberu si biga paila kagwaiguya deli kulisosou kwaitinidesi wala.
